ITEM PARAGRAPHS
A
four-to-six
year-old
child
sits
alone
in
a
room
at
a
table
facing
a
marshmallow
on
a
plate
.
The
child
is
told
:
If
you
don't
eat
this
treat
for
15
minutes
you
can
have
both
this
one
and
a
second
one
.
Kids
on
average
wait
for
five
or
six
minutes
before
eating
the
marshmallow
.
The
longer
a
child
can
resist
the
temptation
has
been
correlated
with
higher
general
competency
later
in
life
.
